market_gap: No production-quality open-source fleet management platform exists. Traccar covers GPS tracking only. Full lifecycle (GPS + maintenance + drivers + inspections + compliance) has no open-source option.
positioning: Nextcloud for fleet management — credible open-source alternative to enterprise platforms

competitors.name: Verizon Connect
competitors.weakness_for_smb: Opaque pricing, long contracts, complex UI

competitors.name: Fleetio
competitors.strengths: Best SMB maintenance platform, clean UX, transparent pricing
competitors.weakness_for_smb: Not a full GPS platform — need separate GPS provider

competitors.name: Traccar (open source)
competitors.strengths: 2000+ GPS device protocols, self-hostable, great tracking
competitors.weakness_for_smb: GPS tracking ONLY — no maintenance, drivers, inspections, fleet management
